title: PANOC-lite: A simpler and more efficient algorithm for composite minimization
summary: This work introduces a simple and efficient linesearch method for composite minimization that accelerates proximal-gradient iterations with fast Newton-type directions. Our algorithm is based on simple operations and only requires the standard proximal-gradient oracle, similar to PANOC and ZeroFPR, provided that the nonsmooth term is convex. Noteworthy improvements include a cheaper backtracking procedure, in the sense that no additional gradients need to be evaluated, and an enlarged range of permitted stepsizes.
